name: lang-kinh-editorial-v2
style_rules: Use layouts to express ideas; keep a common palette.
Keep one narrator per analytical video unless dialogue is intentional.
Do not label symbolic bars as measured data.
Use brief silence and full-bleed breathing shots between dense layouts.

whoosh.prompt: A single refined soft cinematic transition whoosh, fast airy sweep left to right, short smooth tail, clean isolated sound, no voices, no music, not harsh.

impact.prompt: A single warm low cinematic punctuation hit, restrained deep soft thump with a delicate metallic tick on top, short clean decay, no explosion, no voice, no music.

paper.prompt: One crisp tactile page turn and gentle paper slide on a wooden desk, clean close-up editorial foley, no voices, no room noise, no music.

typing.prompt: A short burst of natural laptop keyboard typing, close detailed soft keys, business documentary foley, no voice, no music, no notification.

tick.prompt: Two clean subtle digital UI ticks, precise small glass click followed by a warmer confirmation tone, quiet premium editorial sound, no voice or music.

port.prompt: Soft distant commercial harbor ambience, cranes moving, gentle ship engine rumble, open air, no horns or speech, no music, low intensity documentary background.

review_policy.before_render: Match every named example to footage with the same subject; generic industry is insufficient for a specific sewing-workshop analogy.
review_policy.color: Neutral base grade with per-source overrides; preserve the real object color, do not force all footage into the brand palette.
review_policy.timing: Choose shot cuts from the exact narration alignment, then cue SFX to those cuts.
review_policy.layout: Panels must leave useful footage visible; captions should use concise complete clauses.
review_policy.iterations: Each revision needs a stated observation, real output, technical checks and a reviewed focal sheet; no invented quality score.
review_policy.frame_metadata: Normalize SAR and color metadata between all shots; count decoded frames after final subtitle/mix pass.
